modules.name: Actual durable workflow checks
modules.description: Eight motions, two fresh-data reports, two interruptions and four saved procedures; original verifiers remain authoritative.

finding: Eighteen guarded routes now have one named owner; old evidence and saved results remain verifiable. The original tracked tree contains 17,965,515,667 bytes, including 17,889,852,146 in docs/readmes. The local candidate contains 97,166,929 tracked bytes including its compressed historical catalog. Its fresh local clone has 47,007,859 bytes of Git metadata/objects and took 16.06 seconds on this machine. 52,362 prior frozen files were verified; 69 edition 164 originals were restored from the archive (78,221,935 original bytes).
validation: 95 selected Java tests, 181 desktop tests and nine archive tests passed. Three actual Chromium midpoint/pose checks passed. Four direct boundary/ownership tests also passed in the small candidate clone. Ten completed edition 165 workflows were reverified; ten new edition 166 workflows completed with eight accepted native revisions, two process interruptions and four saved procedure versions. All ten fresh source/numerical/report comparisons match edition 165 exactly.
